description: Source code for WalkieTalkieActivity class managing SIP calls and UI in an Android SIP application.

classes.name: WalkieTalkieActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling SIP registration, call initiation, and UI interactions for the WalkieTalkie app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, registers receiver, and keeps screen on.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Re-initializes SIP manager when activity starts.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, closes calls, and unregisters receiver.

methods.name: initializeManager
methods.description: Creates new SIP manager instance if null and initializes local profile.

methods.name: initializeLocalProfile
methods.description: Registers device with SIP provider using stored preferences.

methods.name: closeLocalProfile
methods.description: Unregisters and releases SIP profile resources.

methods.name: initiateCall
methods.description: Starts an outgoing SIP audio call to the specified address.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Overloaded to update status with call peer info.

methods.name: onTouch
methods.description: Handles mute toggle on touch events.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates menu options for calling, editing SIP info, and hanging up.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu actions for call, settings, and hang up.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates dialogs for calling and updating settings.
